title: [E-Documents Core] - Supported type direction configuration
summary: E-Document services now support per-document-type direction configuration (Incoming, Outgoing, or Both), allowing administrators to control which document types each service can process and preventing implicit document exchanges.
key_points: Adds a Direction field (Incoming, Outgoing, Both) to E-Doc. Service Supported Type, backed by the new closed enum E-Doc. Supp. Type Direction
Outbound creation, recreate and batch export require Outgoing or Both; V1 and V2 inbound processing require Incoming or Both and log an error otherwise
A missing supported-type row now denies both directions; built-in services (PDF reader, ForNAV, Payables Agent, demo) are seeded with Incoming rows
Per-company upgrade turns existing rows into Both and missing types into Incoming, except seven fallback-secondary types left unconfigured
Uses one lookup for non-fallback types, caches the service record in the V2 rejection path, and fixes recurrent and threshold batch export edge cases
